senses.gloss:
प्रपक्षः The extremity of a wing (as of an army); प्रपक्षः शकुनिस्तेषां
 प्रवरैर्हयसादिभिः (ययौ) Mb. 7. 7. 12.

—1 Display, manifestation; रागप्रायः प्रपञ्चः K. 151.
—2 Development, expansion, extension; भरतज्ञकविप्रणीतकाव्यग्रथिताङ्का
 इव नाटकप्रपञ्चाः Śi. 20. 44.
—3 Amplification, expatiation, explanation, elucidation.
—4 Prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness; अलं प्रपञ्चेन.
—5 Manifoldness, diversity.
—6 Heap, abundance, quantity.
—7 An appearance, phenomenon.
—8 Illusion, fraud.
—9 The visible world or universe, which is illusory and the scene of manifold action.
—10 Reciprocal false praise.
—11 Opposition, inversion.
—12 Analysis.
—13 (In dram.) Ludicrous dialogue.
—14 (In gram.) The repetition of an obscure rule in a clearer form.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रपञ्चचतुर, प्रपञ्चबुद्धि, प्रपञ्चवचनम्
प्रपञ्चः + -चतुर a. skilful in assuming different forms; Amaru.
प्रपञ्चः + -बुद्धि a. cunning, deceitful.
प्रपञ्चः + -वचनम् a prolix discourse, diffuse talk.

प्रपञ्चक a.
—1 Displaying, showing.
—2 Developing.
—3 Explaining fully, amplifying, expounding in detail.

—1 Display, development; अरिमध्यस्थमित्राणां सम्यक् चोक्तं प्रपञ्चनम्
 Mb. 12. 59. 52.
—2 Copious exposition, detailed explanation or amplification.

प्रपञ्चयति Den. P.
—1 To show forth, display; प्रपञ्चय पञ्चमम् Gīt. 10.
—2 To expand, amplify, explain in detail, dwell or dilate upon, treat at length.
—3 To cause to appear in a false light.

प्रपञ्चित p. p.
—1 Displayed.
—2 Expanded, amplified.
—3 Dilated upon, fully explained, expatiated upon.
—4 Erring, mistaken.
—5 Deceived, tricked.
प्रपठ् €1 P. To repeat aloud. ━Caus. To teach, explain, expound.

—1 A lesson, lecture.
—2 A chapter or subdivision of a work.
प्रपाठित p. p. Taught, expounded.
प्रपणः Ved. Barter, exchange.

प्रपत् €1 P.
—1 To fly forth or away,
—2 To fly, fly or move about.
—3 To fall down or upon, throw oneself down.
—4 To hasten towards.
—5 To be deprived of, fall from, lose, fall off or away from.
—6 To come down, fall down, descend. ━Caus.
—1 To throw down.
—2 To rout, put to flight.
—3 To chase, pursue.

—1 Flying forth or away.
—2 Throwing oneself into, falling down.
—3 Alighting.
—4 Death, destruction.
—5 A precipice, a steep crag.
—6 Assault; लीयन्ते यत्र शत्रुप्रपतनविवशाः कोटिशः शूरकीटाः Mv. 6. 32.
प्रपातनम् Causing to fall, throwing down (on the ground).

प्रपतित a.
—1 Flown away.
—2 Fallen, come down.
—3 Decayed, wasted.
—4 Dead.

—1 Going forth or away, departure.
—2 Falling down or into, a fall; मनोरथानामतटप्रप्रातः Ś. 6. 10; Ku. 6. 57.
—3 A sudden attack.
—4 A cascade, waterfall, the place over which water falls down; गङ्गाप्रपातान्तनिरूढशष्पं
 गौरीगुरोर्गह्वरमाविवेश R. 2. 26.
—5 A bank, shore.
—6 A precipice, steep rock; प्राप्ताः प्रपातनिकटं सङ्कटेन महीयसा
 Parṇāl. 3. 30.
—7 Falling out or loss, as in केशप्रपात.
—8 Emission, discharge, efflux, as in वीर्यप्रपात.
—9 Throwing oneself down from a rock.
—10 A particular mode of flight.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रपाताम्बु
प्रपातः + -अम्बु n. water falling from a rock.
प्रपातिन् m. A precipitous mountain, cliff.

प्रपथ a. Ved.
—1 Loose, relaxed. —2 Languid, enervated.

प्रपथ + .{@-थः@} A long journey, a journey to a distant place.
—2 A remote place.
—3 A broad street; जुष्टां विभक्तप्रपथाम् Bhāg. 8. 15. 15.
प्रपाथः A road, way.

प्रपथ्य a. Ved.
—1 Being in or on the road.
—2 An epithet of Pūṣan.
प्रपथ्या Yellow myrobalan (Mar. हिरडा).

प्रपद् €4 Ā.
—1 To enter upon, set forward, set foot in.
—2
——(a) To go to or towards, approach, resort or attain to, reach; तां
 जन्मने शैलवधूं प्रपेदे Ku. 1. 21; (क्षितीशं) कौत्सः प्रपेदे
 वरतन्तुशिष्यः R. 5. 1; Bk. 4. 1; Ki. 1. 9, 11. 16; R. 8. 11.
——(b) To take shelter or refuge with, flee to for safety, submit; शरणार्थमन्यां
 कथं प्रपत्स्ये त्वयि दीप्यमाने R. 14. 64.
—3 To go or come to a particular state, arrive at, attain to, arrive at
 or be in a particular condition; रेणुः प्रपेदे पथि पङ्कभावम् R. 16. 30;
 मुहूर्तकर्णोत्पलतां प्रपेदे Ku. 7. 81; बाल्यात्परं साथ
 वयः प्रपेदे Ku. 1. 31, 5. 24; ईदृशीमवस्थां प्रपन्नोस्मि Ś. 5;
 ऋषिनिकरैरिति संशयः प्रपेदे Bv. 4. 33; Amaru. 30.
—4 To get, find, secure, obtain, attain to; partake of, share in; सहकार
 न प्रपेदे मधुपेन भवत्समं जगति Bv. 1. 21; कान्तं वपुर्व्योमचरम्
 प्रपेदे R. 5. 51.
—5 To behave or act towards, deal with; किं प्रपद्यते वैदर्भः M. 1
 ‘what does he propose to do’; पश्यामो मयि किं प्रपद्यते Amaru. 24.
—6 To admit, allow, agree or consent to; प्रपन्नं साधयन्नर्थम् Y. 2. 40.
—7 To draw near, come on, approach (as time &c.).
—8 To be going on, to proceed.
—9 To take effect, thrive, prosper.
—10 To throw oneself down, fall down (at anotherʼs feet).
—11 Ved. To attack, assault.

—1 The forepart of the foot; स तं गृहीत्वा प्रपदोर्भ्रामयित्वैकपाणिना
 Bhāg. 10. 15. 32.
—2 Tip of the toe.

—1 Entrance.
—2 Access, approach; लोकद्वारं विदुषां प्रपदनं निरोधोऽविदुषाम्
 Ch. Up. 8. 6. 5.
—3 Approaching for protection; प्रपदनधनतुष्टाः पञ्चसंस्कारदानात्
 Viś. Guṇā. 255.
प्रपदीन a. Relating or extending to the forepart of the foot.

प्रपन्न p. p.
—1 Arriving at, reaching or going to.
—2 Resorting to, betaking oneself to; इयं प्रपन्ना तपसे तपोवनम्
 Ku. 5. 59, 3. 5.
—3 Taking refuge with, seeking protection with, suppliant or submissive
 to; शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् Bg. 2. 7; पुनर्भवक्लेशभयात्
 प्रपन्नः Ku; प्रपन्नार्तिहरे! देवि! Caṇḍīpāṭha.
—4 Adhering to.
—5 Furnished or endowed with, possessed of; प्रत्यक्षाभिः प्रपन्नस्तनुभिः Ś. 1. 1.
—6 Promised.
—7 Got, obtained.
—8 Poor, distressed.
—9 Effecting, producing.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रपन्नपालः
प्रपन्न + -पालः an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
प्रपादः Ved. Miscarriage.
प्रपन्नाडः See प्रपुनाट.
प्रपर्ण a. Devoid of leaves (as a tree; प्रपतितानि पर्णानि यस्य).
प्रपर्ण + .{@-र्णम्@} A fallen leaf.
प्रपलायनम् Flight, retreat.

प्रपलायित a.
—1 Run away.
—2 Routed, defeated.

प्रपलायिन् a.
—1 Flying, escaping.
—2 A fugitive.

—1 A place where water is distributed to travellers; भूतानामिह संवासः
 प्रपायामिव सुव्रते Bhāg. 7. 2. 21; व्याख्यास्थानान्यमलसलिला यस्य
 कूपाः प्रपाश्च Vikr. 18. 78.
—2 A well, cistern; यस्तु रज्जुं घटं कूपाद्धरेद्भिद्याच्च यः प्रपाम् Ms. 8. 319.
—3 A place for watering cattle.
—4 A supply of water.
—5 A draught.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रपापालिका, प्रपावनम्
प्राप a. Arriving at, reaching, obtaining &c.; as in दुष्प्राप.

प्रपा + -पालिका a woman who distributes water to travellers; भूपेषु
 कूपेष्विव रिक्तभावं कृत्वा प्रपापालिकयैव यस्य Vikr. 1. 89, 13. 10.
प्रपा + -वनम् a cool grove.

—1 Ripening (of a boil &c.).
—2 Inflammation.
प्रापक + .{@-कः@} Bringer, procurer.

—1 The forepart of the hand.
—2 The palm of the extended hand.
प्रपाण्डु a. Very white.
प्रपादिकः A peacock.

—1 Drinking.
—2 The underpart of a horseʼs upper lip.
प्रपानकम् A kind of drink; प्रपानकरसन्यायाच्चर्व्यमाणो रसो भवेत् S. D.
प्रपालनम् Protecting, guarding.
प्रपालिन् m. An epithet of Balarāma.

—1 A paternal great-grandfather.
—2 An epithet of Kṛṣṇa; प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च Bg. 11. 39.
—3 Of Brahman.
—4 Of the Supreme Spirit.

प्रपितामहः + .{@-ही@} A paternal great-grandmother; पितामही च स्वेनैव स्वेनैव
 प्रपितामही Dāy. B.
प्रपितृव्यः A paternal grand-uncle.

प्रपीड् €10 U.
—1 To press, squeeze.
—2 To torture, torment, harass, afflict.
—3 To check, suppress, restrain.

—1 Pressing, squeezing.
—2 An astringent.

प्रपीत (-न) a.
 Swollen up, distended.

प्रापित p. p.
—1 Conveyed, conducted.
—2 Led to, promoted or advanced to.
—3 Caused to obtain.
—4 Procured, got.
—4 Brought before (the king); commenced (as a law-suit); न च प्रापितमन्येन
 प्रसेदर्थं कथंचन Ms. 8. 43.

प्रपीत (-न) a.
 Swollen up, distended.
प्रपुत्रः A grandson, descendant.
प्रपुना(न्ना)टः, -डः N. of a tree (चकमर्द).
प्रपुना(न्ना)टः, -डः N. of a tree (चकमर्द).
प्रपुना(न्ना)टः, -डः N. of a tree (चकमर्द).
प्रपुराण a. Very old, kept for a long time.

—1 The Supreme Being.
—2 N. of the two Aśvins.
प्रपुष्पित a. Flowering, blooming.
प्रपृष्ठ a. Having a prominent back; P. VI. 2. 177 com.
प्रपॄ €9 P. To fill up, complete. ━Pass. To be filled or completed; be fulfilled.
प्रपूरक a. Fulfilling, satisfying.

—1 Filling, filling up, completing.
—2 Inserting, injecting.
—3 Satisfying; satiating.
—4 Attaching to, affixing.
—5 Bending (of a bow); क्व गतिर्मानुषाणां च धनुषोऽस्य प्रपूरणे
 Rām. 1. 67. 10.
प्रपूरित p. p. Filled up.

प्रपौण्डरीकः A kind of shrub (पौण्डर्य); प्रपौण्डरीकमधुकपिप्पलीचन्दनोत्पलैः … …
 Cakrapāṇidatta.
प्रपौत्रः A great-grandson; लोकानन्त्यं दिवः प्राप्तिः पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रकैः Y. 1. 78.
प्रपौत्रः + .{@-त्री@} A great-grand-daughter.
प्रप्यायनम् Swelling.

प्राप् €5 P. To get, obtain, gain, acquire; अतिथिं नाम काकुत्स्थात्
 पुत्रं प्राप कुमुद्वती R. 17. 1.
—2 To attain to, go to, reach; यथा महाह्रदं प्राप्य क्षिप्तं लोष्टं
 विनश्यति Ms. 11. 264; R. 1. 48; Bk. 15. 106; so आश्रमम्, नदीम्, वनम्
 &c.; प्राप्यावन्तीन् Me. 30.
—3 To stretch, extend.
—4 To meet with, find, light upon, overtake; जटायुः प्राप पक्षीन्द्रः
 परुषं रावणं वदन् Bk. 5. 96.
—5 To result or follow (as a conclusion); परिच्छिन्नस्तावज्जीव इति प्राप्नोति Ś. B.
—6 To incur, bring upon oneself (दोष, दण्ड &c.); स शतं प्राप्नुयाद्दण्डम् Ms. 8. 225.
—7 To suffer, endure; न वधं प्राप्नुयान्नरः Ms. 8. 364.
—8 To be changed into (in gram.).
—9 To be present, be at hand (Ved.). ━Caus.
—1 To lead or bring to, take to, convey; सपत्नीः प्रापयन्त्यब्धिं सिन्धवो
 नगनिम्नगाः Śi. 2. 104; वसतिं प्रिय कामिनां प्रियास्त्वदृते प्रापयितुं
 क ईश्वरः Ku. 4. 11, 32; Ve. 3. 7; R. 14. 45, 60.
—2 To cause to obtain, give, provide; अभिमन्युतनयमसून् प्रापितवान्
 K. 175 ‘restored to life, revived’.
—3 To promote or advance, appoint to (an office).
—4 To tell, communicate.

प्रापक (-पिका f.)
 [प्राप्-ण्वुल्]
—1 Leading to, conveying.
—2 Procuring, providing with.
—3 Establishing, making valid.
—4 Obtaining.

—1 Reaching, extending to.
—2 Obtaining, acquisition, attainment.
—3 Bringing to, conveying, leading to.
—4 Procuring.
—5 Reference.
—6 Elucidation, explanation.

प्रापिपयिषु a. Wishing to cause to reach; प्रतीतस्तत्किं मामतिभरमधः
 प्रापिपयिषुः Śi. 5. 69.

प्राप्त p. p.
—1 Got, obtained, won, acquired.
—2 Reached, attained to.
—3 Met with, found.
—4 Incurred, suffered, endured; सभार्येण सराष्ट्रेण यत् प्राप्तं तत्र
 तत्त्वतः (संप्रपश्यति) Rām. 1. 3. 3.
—5 Arrived, come, present.
—6 Completed.
—7 Proper, right.
—8 Following from a rule.
—9 Described (as a symptom).
—10 Fixed, placed.
—11 (In gram.) Following from a rule, valid.

प्राप्त + -अनुज्ञ a. one who has got permission to go, allowed to depart.
प्राप्त + -अपराघ a. guilty of an offence.
प्राप्त + -अर्थ a. successful.
प्राप्त + -अर्थ + .({@-र्थः@}) an object gained.

प्राप्त + -अवसर a.
—1 finding occasion or opportunity.
—2 timely, seasonable.
प्राप्त + -अवसर + .({@-रः@}) a fit or suitable time.
प्राप्त + -उदय a. one who has attained rise or exaltation.
प्राप्त + -कर्मन् n. that which results or follows from a preceding rule.
प्राप्त + -कारिन् a. doing what is right.

प्राप्त + -काल a.
—1 opportune, seasonable, suitable; see अप्राप्तकाल.
—2 marriageable.
—3 fated, destined.
प्राप्त + -काल + .({@-लः@}) a fit time, suitable or favourable moment.

प्राप्त + -काल + .({@-लम्@}) ind. seasonably, opportunely, timely; अप्राप्तकालं
 वचनं वृहस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन् Pt. 1. 63.
प्राप्त + -क्रम a. fit, proper, suitable.
प्राप्त + -जीवन a. revived, restored to life.
प्राप्त + -दोष a. guilty.

प्राप्त + -पञ्चत्व a. resolved into the five elements, i. e. dead;
 cf. पञ्चत्व.

प्राप्त + -प्रसव a.
—1 delivered of a child.
—2 near her confinement; प्राप्तप्रसवमात्मानं गङ्गादेव्यां विमुञ्चति U. 7. 2.
प्राप्त + -बीज a. sown.

प्राप्त + -बुद्धि a.
—1 recovering, regaining oneʼs consciousness.
—2 instructed, enlightened.
प्राप्त + -भारः a beast of burden.

प्राप्त + -भाव a.
—1 wise.
—2 handsome.
प्राप्त + -भावः a young bullock.
प्राप्त + -मनोरथ a. one who has obtained his desired object.

प्राप्त + -यौवन a. being in the bloom of youth, arrived at the age
 of puberty, youthful.

प्राप्त + -रूप a.
—1 handsome, beautiful.
—2 wise, learned.
—3 charming, attractive.
—4 fit, proper, worthy.
प्राप्त + -वर a. fraught with blessings.

प्राप्त + -व्यवहार a. come of age, being able and legally authorised
 to manage his own affairs (opp. ‘minor’).

प्राप्त + -श्री a. one who owes his rise (to another); इतः स दैत्यः
 प्राप्तश्रीर्नेत एवार्हति क्षयम् Ku. 2. 55; Pt. 1. 244.
प्राप्त + -सूर्य a. having the sun (vertical).

प्राप्तिः f.
—1 Obtaining, acquisition gain, attainment, profit; द्रव्य˚, यशः˚,
 सुख˚ &c.; अप्राप्तस्यैव या प्राप्तिः सैव संयोग उच्यते Bhāṣā P.
—2 Reaching or attaining to.
—3 Arrival, coming to.
—4 Finding, meeting with.
—5 Range, reach.
—6 A guess, conjecture.
—7 Lot, share, portion.
—8 Fortune, luck.
—9 Rise, production.
—10 The power of obtaining anything (one of the eight Siddhis, q. v.).
—11 Union, collection (संहति).
—12 The result of actions done in a former life.
—13 Fate, destiny; पक्षिणां तदपि प्राप्त्या नादत्तमुपतिष्ठति Pt. 2. 127.
—14 Being valid, holding good, application (as of a rule).
—15 The successful termination of a plot (सुखागम).
—16 (In Rhet.) A conjecture based on the observation of a particular thing.
—17 (In astrol.) N. of the 11th lunar mansion.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्राप्त्याशा, प्राप्तिसमम्

प्राप्तिः + -आशा the hope of obtaining anything
[]
 (regarded as part of the development of the plot of a play); उपायापायशङ्काभ्यां
 प्राप्त्याशा प्राप्तिसंभवा S. D. 6.
प्राप्तिः + -समम् a particular Jāti in Nyāya.

प्राप्य, प्राप्तव्य pot. p.
—1 To be got or obtained.
—2 Attainable, procurable; destined to be got; प्राप्तव्यमर्थं लभते
 मनुष्यः Pt. 2. 110.
—3 To be reached, attainable.
—4 To be met with or found.
—5 Proper, fit, suitable.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्राप्यकारिन्, प्राप्यरूप

प्राप्य, प्राप्तव्य pot. p.
